eqs.description: list List of expressions to be factored. Each expression is assumed to be equal to zero.
constraints: Each element must satisfy Expr or complex type

gens.description: list, optional Generator(s) of the polynomial ring. If not provided, all free symbols will be used.
constraints: Each element must satisfy Expr type

output.description: ======= list[list[Expr]] A list of lists of expressions, where each sublist represents an irreducible subsystem. When solved, each subsystem gives one component of the solution. Only generic solutions are returned (cases not requiring parameters to be zero).

constraints: kwargs is optional and takes any arguments accepted by sympy's factor function
